meta.name: East of Eden
meta.description:
In the early 1900s, a fiercely independent woman drives a rift between two brothers, igniting a saga that unfolds across two generations.

Complete series. On your server: S1 7/7

videos.title: Brothers
videos.overview: Torn apart by a domineering father, brothers Adam and Charles Trask are forced into opposing paths to adulthood — one far away, one close to home.

videos.title: Cathy
videos.overview: Cathy revisits her dark past, as her presence in the brothers' home sows discord in the present.

videos.title: In the Valley
videos.overview: While Adam pursues his dream of a home and family in California, Cathy has her own ideas about the future.

videos.title: Kate
videos.overview: Cathy starts over with a new name, a new life and a ruthless plan to achieve financial independence.

videos.title: Departure
videos.overview: Ten years on, an encounter with Cathy shifts Adam's perspective, as he and Lee clash over telling the boys the truth about their mother.

videos.title: The Great Try
videos.overview: Adam embarks on a bold new business venture. An alienated Cal is drawn to his family's past, while Cathy's begins to catch up with her.

videos.title: Timshel
videos.overview: With World War I looming, the family wonders if the sins of the past can ever be erased — and whether a new generation is doomed to repeat them.
